 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R It is pointed out that the petitioner  Abhishek Srivastava has not been released on interim bail in terms of this Courts order dated 17.05.2023, as he is in custody upon conviction in Sessions Trial no. 277/2023 arising out of R.C. no. 9(A)/2010 registered with Police Station  CBI/SPE/ACB,
District Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh for the offence(s) punishable under Section 120B, 419, 420, 467,
468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 13(2) and 13(1)(d) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.

In view of the aforesaid position, we are inclined to accept the prayer made by the petitioner  Abhishek Srivastava and direct that he will be released on interim bail, in both Criminal Appeal no.
922/2023 arising out of R.C. no. 9(A)/2010, pending before the High Court of Judicature at A l l a h a b a d , L u c k n o w B e n c h a n d C o m p l a i n t C a s e n o . 5 4 / 2 0 1 9 i n E C I R n o .
ECIR/03/PMLA/LKZO/2010, for a period of two weeks from the date of release, on the terms and conditions to be fixed by the trial court.
The petitioner  Abhishek Srivastava will furnish a mobile phone number on which the officer(s) of the respondent can contact him to ascertain his whereabouts.
The petitioner  Abhishek Srivastava will surrender his passport and will not move out of his SLP(Crl.) No. 1572/2023 etc. hometown without the permission of the trial court.
However, the petitioner will be entitled to visit Delhi for medical treatment at Delhi.
The details and particulars with regard to the visit and stay in Delhi for medical treatment shall be informed to the trial court.
In view of the above directions, SLP(Crl.) No. 9090/2023 stands disposed of.
Re -list SLP(Crl.) No. 1572/2023 in the month of November 2023.

(DEEPAK GUGLANI) (R.S. NARAYANAN)
